info.description: A short, reader-submitted comment for the public comment wall ("Can reputation be sold?"). Lower-friction than a full User Story — no account required — and every comment is held in moderation before it appears.

authorDisplayName.description: Optional public name/handle. Ignored when isAnonymous is true.

localeSubmitted.description: UI locale the comment was written from (en, ru, ka, ...). Display only — comments are not translated.

country.description: Optional self-reported country/region of the affected reader.

moderationNotes.description: Internal editor notes — never shown to readers.

ipHash.description: Salted hash of submitter IP — abuse/rate-limit forensics only, never displayed.
